lines.text: If you think peace lasts, why did 12 out of 16 great powers fail to stop world war before it broke out?
lines.subtitle: If you think peace lasts, why did 12 out of 16 great powers fail to stop world war before it broke out?

lines.text: 2,400 years ago, Greek historian Thucydides identified the pattern: 'It was the rise of Athens and the fear this instilled in Sparta that made war inevitable.'
lines.subtitle: 2,400 years ago, Greek historian Thucydides identified the pattern: 'It was the rise of Athens and the fear this instilled in Sparta that made war inevitable.'

lines.text: Today, that chessboard shifted to the Pacific. Washington is the established superpower. Beijing is the challenger rising at historic speed.
lines.subtitle: Today, that chessboard shifted to the Pacific. Washington is the established superpower. Beijing is the challenger rising at historic speed.

lines.text: China now commands the largest naval fleet on Earth. And America's defense perimeter runs straight through this 100-mile strait.
lines.subtitle: China now commands the largest naval fleet on Earth. And America's defense perimeter runs straight through this 100-mile strait.

lines.text: When the hegemon feels surrounded and the challenger feels contained, miscalculation is fatal. Are we doomed to repeat it?
lines.subtitle: When the hegemon feels surrounded and the challenger feels contained, miscalculation is fatal. Are we doomed to repeat it?
